name: Unpickling downloaded artifacts (pickle/joblib/pandas)
attack_scenario: A shared sklearn .pkl on an internal S3 bucket is swapped by an attacker; joblib.load runs the crafted __reduce__ and executes os.system during model load.
negative_test_hint:
load a crafted pickle stream "cos
system
(S'id'
tR." and assert the loader refuses it or sandboxing prevents the embedded os.system call

exemplar.explanation: pickle/joblib/pandas.read_pickle reconstruct arbitrary objects via __reduce__, so deserializing any artifact you did not produce is remote code execution. Use JSON/parquet/safetensors for untrusted data.
